messages.content: 我想訂製一尊馬的青銅雕塑。有哪些材料選擇？

function.name: painting_create_custom
function.description: Order a custom painting with your preferred color. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

subject.description: The subject of the painting, e.g. horse

color.description: Preferred main color for the painting.

size.description: The desired size for the painting in inches. This parameter is optional. Default 12

function.name: sculpture_create_custom
function.description: Order a custom sculpture with your preferred material. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

item.description: The subject of the sculpture, e.g. horse

size.description: The desired size for the sculpture in inches. This parameter is optional. Default 12

message.content:
您可以選擇以下材料來訂製馬的雕塑：

| 材料 | 特色 |
|------|------|
| 青銅 (Bronze) | 耐久、光澤感強，適合戶外或室內展示 |
| 大理石 (Marble) | 高雅、質感細膩，適合正式場合 |
| 陶土 (Terracotta) | 低成本、可塑性好，適合小型作品 |
| 木材 (Wood) | 自然紋理，溫暖感，易於加工 |
| 石材 (Stone) | 堅固、重量感強，適合大型雕塑 |

您已經提到想訂製一尊 **青銅** 馬雕塑。請問您想要的尺寸（英吋）是多少？如果不確定，我們可以使用預設尺寸 12 英吋。您也可以告訴我是否需要其他特殊要求（例如表面處理、底座等）。
message.reasoning:
The user says: "我想訂製一尊馬的青銅雕塑。有哪些材料選擇？" They want to order a bronze sculpture of a horse. They ask: "有哪些材料選擇？" They want to know material options. According to the function, the sculpture_create_custom function has parameters: item (subject), material (Bronze, Marble, Terracotta, Wood, Stone), size optional. The user wants bronze. They ask about material options. We can respond with the available materials: Bronze, Marble, Terracotta, Wood, Stone. Then we can offer to place an order. We can ask for size or confirm. The user specifically wants bronze. So we can confirm that bronze is available. We can ask for size. Or we can just proceed with default size 12. But better to ask for size. So we can respond: "您可以選擇青銅、大理石、陶土、木材或石材。您想訂製青銅馬雕塑，請告訴我尺寸（英吋）或使用預設12英吋。"

We should not call the function yet because we need more info. So we respond with the options and ask for size.
